title: Pass on the work rules

scenario.en: A new worker does not read English. The boss explained the rules to you.
scenario.ar: موظف جديد مش بيقرا إنجليزي. المدير شرحلك القواعد.

source: The boss said: 'You have to arrive at eight o'clock. You mustn't use your phone in a meeting. You don't have to wear the uniform on Friday. If you are sick, you must call the office early.'

task.en: Tell the new worker the four rules.

key_points.en: You have to arrive at eight o'clock.
You mustn't use your phone in a meeting.
You don't have to wear the uniform on Friday.
key_points.ar: مش لازم تلبس الزي يوم الجمعة.

key_points.en: If you are sick, you must call the office early.
key_points.ar: لو عيّان لازم تكلّم المكتب بدري.

model_answer.en: You have to arrive at eight o'clock, and you mustn't use your phone in a meeting. You don't have to wear the uniform on Friday. If you are sick, you must call the office early.
model_answer.ar: لازم توصل الساعة تمانية، وممنوع تستخدم التليفون في الاجتماع. ومش لازم تلبس الزي يوم الجمعة. ولو عيّان لازم تكلّم المكتب بدري.
